case_number: Miscellaneous Application No 2680 of 2019; Arbitration Case (Civil) No 38 of 2017

parties.petitioner: Tata Sons Pvt Ltd (Formerly Tata Sons Ltd)
parties.respondent: Siva Industries and Holdings Ltd & Ors

summary: International commercial arbitration; mandate extension under Section 29A Arbitration Act; moratorium under IBC; CIRP lifted; amendment to Section 29A w.e.f. 30 August 2019; tribunal's mandate termination avoided; proceedings allowed to continue; automatic continuation post-amendment considered; fees reduction if delay attributable to tribunal.
final_judgment: Arbitration proceedings allowed to continue; extension of mandate granted; tribunal directed to dispose expeditiously; no reduction in fees at this stage.
